slice: P2 source-bound AC1027 MLEADERSTYLE group-170 contentType
scope: One runtime-authored AC1027 DXF source with a root-reachable STANDARD MLEADERSTYLE record. It contains one group-170 INTEGER contentType value 0 and the other selected control/order enum fields. The selected transaction changes only contentType from NoneContent=0 to ToleranceContent=3; all other encoded style fields remain unchanged.

fieldEvidence.fieldRoleSource: Autodesk AutoCAD DXF Reference, MLEADERSTYLE group-code table identifies code 170 as Content Type
fieldEvidence.valueDomainSource: Autodesk AutoCAD 2026 ObjectARX Managed Reference wraps AcDbMLeaderStyle::ContentType and lists NoneContent, BlockContent, MTextContent, and ToleranceContent; ordinal values are 0..3
fieldEvidence.classification: Authoritative Autodesk DXF field-role and ObjectARX enum-domain evidence plus authored adapter transaction; not independent producer or native tolerance-content semantic acceptance

contract.admission: Source and target must both be AC1027. The selected record must be reachable through the validated ACAD_MLEADERSTYLE dictionary, have one source-matched raw body and immutable source baseline, and contain exactly one existing group-170 INTEGER corresponding to parsed contentType. The target value must be within the documented enum range 0..3. contentType must be the only changed typed payload field; identity, common fields, handles, application data, extension data and all other encoded style fields must match the source.
contract.projection: Replace only the existing physical group-170 value in a copy of the captured raw body. Preserve all other ordered fields and opaque groups. Missing/repeated group 170, conflicting raw changes, simultaneous edits, values outside 0..3, unknown subclass grammar and non-AC1027 routes remain outside this transaction.
contract.outputAndReadback: The table-driven regression exercises the group-170 field on ASCII and binary sources, same-format and opposite-format output. It checks one exact literal emitted group-170 INTEGER value 3 and fresh typed readback as contentType=3 while text/control/attachment enum fields remain at their source values.
contract.failureAndRetry: Changing captured raw group 170 from 0 to 1 while typed contentType requests 3 refuses and preserves a sentinel destination. Value 4 also refuses atomically. Restoring the original raw body and requesting valid value 3 permits same-adapter retry. Exact output and fresh-readback checks pass after retry.
contract.compatibility: Untouched MLEADERSTYLE records keep existing raw replay. Transactions are not admitted for other source or target versions or multiple changes on one record. DWG-origin writing is unchanged. Test sources and outputs are authored at runtime in a temporary directory and removed; no drawing fixture is committed.

sourceBindings.fixtureRecipe: generateRootMLeaderStyleControl in tests/dwg2dxf_adapter_tests.cpp emits group 170=0 in the STANDARD source plus the related control/order and text/attachment fields. ASCII and binary sources are generated locally from scratch at test runtime.
